notes:
The app wears its real badge. The launcher icon and the card in the
recents switcher both show the Venture mark now, and that card's header
is the app's own dark rather than the near-white grey it had been.

The +/- zoom buttons are gone from all three map screens. They sat
underneath the on-screen controls where nothing could reach them, and
pinch already does the job.

The plan screen's bottom bar carries icons on BACK, LOCATE, UNDO and
SAVE, so it can be read at a glance rather than word by word. LOCATE
still spells out why there is no fix whenever there isn't one.
